**Risk flags:**
- Single shareholder holds 89.6%

**Overview:**  
Harmoni Murni Catering Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated on 24 Oct 2004, operating in Selangor’s food & beverage sector and wholesaling frozen food to restaurants. It was formerly known as Kirana Industries Sdn. Bhd. (name change 26 Sep 2024). The firm has three directors, a dominant shareholder owning 89.6% of equity, and a share capital of RM2.5 million. Reported revenues are RM9.22 million, RM10.19 million and RM12.29 million in the three most recent periods, with equity ranging between RM1.92 million and RM2.27 million. No legal cases are recorded.
